primary.title: Paid the last instalment of your home loan EMI? Do not forget to collect these documents from your bank
primary.summary: Celebrating a paid-off home loan is essential, but ensure to collect original documents, including sale deeds and No Dues Certificates. Per RBI guidelines, lenders must return these within 30 days; failure results in compensation.
